items.title: It's not even close: Gen Z is outspending every other generation at restaurants
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma reports on a Bank of America Institute study that found Gen Z is the leading generation in restaurant spending, more than doubling the spending of the next generation.

items.title: BofA Analyst Says Nvidia Is ‘Checking Every Box’ Ahead Of Earnings, Sees $1B Daily Free Cash Flow By This Time Next Year
items.summary: In an interview with CNBC, BofA analyst Vivek Arya said investors are likely to pay closer attention to how Nvidia deploys the enormous cash it generates than to the earnings themselves.

items.title: Jim Cramer sends a strong message to Meta stock investors
items.summary: Cramer reached a conclusion about Meta that Bank of America is backing with a specific number.

items.title: How To Use A Covered Strangle Trade On This Banking Giant
items.summary: Bank of America stock works as a covered strangle, a strategy for investors who already own shares and want to add more.

items.title: BofA's Ike: Economic Stability Driving Africa IPO Boom
items.summary: Improving economic conditions are driving renewed activity in Africa's capital markets according to Yvonne Ike at Bank of America. She spoke to Chief Africa correspondent Jennifer Zabasajja on Bloomberg's Next Africa program.

items.title: INTU Stock Plummets After Q4 Results Leave Wall Street Divided: ‘Unsatisfying Growth’ Meets ‘Foundations Take Time’
items.summary: Analysts said Intuit’s AI risks are extending beyond TurboTax into the company’s QuickBooks business.

items.title: What Bank of America (BAC)'s New Debt Issuance and AI Credit Research Push Means For Shareholders
items.summary: In August 2026, Bank of America Corporation issued several senior unsecured medium-term notes, including fixed-rate bonds maturing between 2029 and 2046 and a US$15.00 million callable step-up note due 2036. Alongside these offerings, Bank of America’s recent research highlights how AI is reshaping leveraged finance and how younger, lower-income consumers are shifting more spending toward independent restaurants. items.title: AI Trade at Risk From US Voter Ire Over Buildout, Barclays Says
items.summary: The relentless buildout of artificial intelligence infrastructure is drawing bipartisan backlash, which could introduce political risk to the market’s beloved trade ahead of the US midterm election.
